title: State, remember, rememberSaveable, and the rotation that used to destroy everything

videos.script: A screen that cannot change is a poster. This lesson is about the values that make a screen change, and about keeping them. {{triggers}} Three counters, three buttons, and only one of them works. A plain variable changes and nobody notices. A state object without remember is noticed, and then thrown away. {{remember}} Then remember itself: a value kept in the composition, for as long as its composable stays on screen. {{rotation}} Then the turn of the phone. Two counters at fifty, one rotation, and one of them is back to zero. The other was saved in the Bundle you met in lesson 2. {{savers}} Then a draft that cannot be saved, a test that fails with a precise message, and the four lines that fix it. {{hoisting}} And last, who owns a value. A picker that can only ask, and a screen that decides.
